Starting Balances — Fixed Assets

This guide explains how to set up starting balances for your fixed assets in Manager. Before you begin, ensure you have created your fixed assets under the Fixed Assets tab.

Setting Up a Starting Balance

To create a starting balance for a fixed asset:

  1. Navigate to the Starting Balances section for fixed assets.

  2. Click the New Starting Balance button.

    FixedAssetsNewStartingBalance

  3. You will be taken to the Starting Balance screen for fixed assets.

For detailed instructions on completing the starting balance form, see Starting Balance for Fixed Asset Form.
